lines.en: label day215:
scene black
scene twowoodendoors1
Two wooden doors and the feeling that something horrible is going to happen cloud my thoughts as I sit in my chair and wait for the day to end.
lines.zh: 我坐在椅子上等着这一天结束，两扇木门，以及「有什么可怕的事即将发生」的预感，充斥着我的思绪。

lines.en: It’s a good chair.
lines.zh: 这是把好椅子。

lines.en: I’ve come to find it comfortable on several occasions now.
lines.zh: 有好几次我都觉得它相当舒服。

lines.en: The fabric is easily warmed up by my body heat and only scratches mildly against exposed skin.
lines.zh: 布料很容易被我的体温焐热，蹭在裸露的皮肤上也只是微微发痒。

lines.en: Not like my skin is ever exposed in it to begin with.
lines.zh: 虽说我的皮肤本来也没怎么露出来过。

lines.en: Apart from all of the times I've touched myself while waiting for the day to end, at least.
lines.zh: 至少，除了那些我一边等着一天结束、一边自己动手的时候。

lines.en: My skin touches the chair when that happens.
lines.zh: 那种时候，我的皮肤可是会碰到椅子的。

lines.en: I remember the light scratch of the fabric as my balls brush against it better than I remember most things.
lines.zh: 我记着布料轻轻刮过卵蛋的感觉，比记得大多数事情都清楚。

lines.en: But then again, the dried remnants of my self-pleasure that coat the underside of my desk are just one more article on the ever growing list of things that will not cling to my mind any longer than necessary.
lines.zh: 不过话又说回来，糊在我桌子底面、早已干掉的那些自我安慰的残渍，也不过是我那份不断变长的清单上的又一条——那些不必久留于脑海的东西。

lines.en: Why doesn't anything ever cling when I want it to?
lines.zh: 为什么我想要记住什么的时候，什么都留不下来？

lines.en: : You’re not with anyone in there, are you?
lines.zh: : 你里面没跟谁在一起吧？

lines.en: : No. I’m free.
lines.zh: : 没有。我闲着呢。

lines.en: : Okay.
: I’m coming in.
lines.zh: : 我进来了。

lines.en: scene twowoodendoors2
Two wooden doors and a normal [teenage]girl cloud my thoughts as I sit in a chair with only slightly-scratchy fabric and dwell on the negative emotions lurking somewhere behind my eyes.
lines.zh: 我坐在那把布料只是微微发痒的椅子上，任两扇木门和一个普通的 [teenage]女孩填满思绪，反复咀嚼着藏在眼底某处的那些负面情绪。

lines.en: She’s probably here to warn me about something.
lines.zh: 她大概是来警告我什么的。

lines.en: : Good evening.
lines.zh: : 晚上好。

lines.en: : Hey. I’m assuming you didn’t just come to say hello?
lines.zh: : 嘿。我猜你不只是来打个招呼的吧？

lines.en: : Of course not.
lines.zh: : 那当然。

lines.en: : I’m here to tell you the world is going to end soon.
lines.zh: : 我是来告诉你，世界很快就要终结了。

lines.en: : Of course you are.
lines.zh: : 你当然是为这个来的。

lines.en: : Are you prepared this time?
lines.zh: : 这一次你准备好了吗？

lines.en: : You aren’t going to take forever to find me again, are you?
lines.zh: : 你不会又拖上好久才找到我吧？

lines.en: : Will you be in the same place as last time?
lines.zh: : 你会在上次的同一个地方吗？

lines.en: : You mean the same place I always reset everything? Yes.
lines.zh: : 你是指我每次重置一切的那个地方？是的。

lines.en: : Then, yeah. I’ll meet you on the rooftop.
lines.zh: : 那么，好。我们天台上见。

lines.en: : Good. I wish you the best of luck.
lines.zh: : 很好。祝你好运。

lines.en: : Thanks...
lines.zh: : 谢了……

lines.en: : Is that all?
lines.zh: : 就这些？

lines.en: scene twowoodendoors3
: You seem eager to get rid of me.
lines.zh: : 你看起来很想赶我走。

lines.en: : Please don’t assume this is me going out of my way for you, but is there something troubling you by any chance?
lines.zh: : 请你别以为我是在特地关心你，不过你是不是有什么烦心事？

lines.en: : Your mental state directly correlates to how long I’m going to have to wait on that rooftop for.
lines.zh: : 你的精神状态直接关系到我要在那个天台上等你多久。

lines.en: : So if you’re not feeling well, I may have to come get you myself.
lines.zh: : 所以如果你状态不好，我可能得亲自来接你。

lines.en: scene twowoodendoors4
: And that...
lines.zh: : 而那……

lines.en: : Would bother me.
lines.zh: : 会让我很困扰。

lines.en: : I’ve actually been wondering about a lot of things lately. Ever since Halloween.
lines.zh: : 说实话，最近我确实一直在琢磨很多事。从万圣节之后就开始了。

lines.en: scene twowoodendoors5
: What have you been wondering?
lines.zh: : 你在琢磨什么？

lines.en: : I’m by no means as all-knowing as you assume I am, but if it’s something that isn’t too annoying, I might be able to answer now.
lines.zh: : 我可远没有你以为的那么全知，不过如果问题不算太烦人，我现在也许能回答。

lines.en: : Well, to start, I’ve been kind of worried about Molly and Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 嗯，首先，我一直有点担心 Molly 和 Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : Interesting. Why?
lines.zh: : 有意思。为什么？

lines.en: : Wasn’t their arrival strange? They weren’t there at all until after the world reset.
lines.zh: : 她们的出现不是很奇怪吗？在世界重置之前，她们根本就不存在。

lines.en: : They just kind of showed up one day and-
lines.zh: : 她们就这么在某一天突然冒了出来，然后——

lines.en: scene twowoodendoors6
: And you’re worried they’re going to go away just as easily.
lines.zh: : 而你担心她们会同样轻易地消失。

lines.en: : Did you really become so attached to those two in such a short time?
lines.zh: : 你真的在这么短的时间里就对她们这么上心了？

lines.en: : They’re the ones who have grown attached to me. I just don’t want them to be upset if they keep their memories of all of this and then just...
lines.zh: : 是她们对我上了心。我只是不想让她们在保留着这一切记忆之后，还要难过地……

lines.en: : Suddenly have to tell themselves it was all a lie.
lines.zh: : 突然不得不告诉自己，这一切都是假的。

lines.en: scene twowoodendoors7
: You actually worry about things like that?
lines.zh: : 你居然会操心这种事？

lines.en: : Reluctantly. Just a side effect of having compassion, I guess.
lines.zh: : 不太情愿地操心吧。大概是有同情心的副作用。

lines.en: : You and compassion don’t exactly mix.
lines.zh: : 你和同情心可不太搭。

lines.en: : Tell me about it.
lines.zh: : 这我还能不知道吗。

lines.en: scene twowoodendoors8
Maya closes her eyes and takes a deep breath.
lines.zh: Maya 闭上眼睛，深吸了一口气。

lines.en: A while ago, I feel like getting her to be comfortable enough to even blink around me was taxing.
lines.zh: 曾几何时，光是让她在我面前放松到愿意眨一下眼睛，都让我觉得费力。

lines.en: The fact that she keeps her eyes closed for a total of seven seconds as she debates how to respond to me is proof of how far we have come since back then.
lines.zh: 她在斟酌如何回应我时，眼睛整整闭了七秒——这证明比起那时，我们已经走了多远。

lines.en: And perhaps proof of how far she will fall if this reset isn’t as successful as the last.
lines.zh: 也许也证明着，如果这次重置不如上次成功，她会跌得有多惨。

lines.en: scene twowoodendoors9
: I don’t know what will happen with those two.
lines.zh: : 我不知道她们俩会怎么样。

lines.en: : Their transfer into the class wasn’t a one-time thing. It’s happened before.
lines.zh: : 她们转进这个班并不是只发生过一次的事。以前也有过。

lines.en: : But it’s rare.
lines.zh: : 不过很罕见。

lines.en: : I suppose it’s just based on circumstance or RNG or something along those lines.
lines.zh: : 我想这大概取决于情境，或者随机数之类的东西。

lines.en: : But I wouldn’t get my hopes up of them returning.
lines.zh: : 不过我不会对她们回来抱太大希望。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 这样啊。

lines.en: I figured the answer would be something like that.
lines.zh: 我猜答案就是这样。

lines.en: But I guess that means there’s no use beating myself up over it.
lines.zh: 不过这也意味着，为此折磨自己也毫无意义。

lines.en: I’ll just let time be the cruel bitch that it is and steal away some of the gifts that I’ve obtained purely due to chance.
lines.zh: 就让时间继续当它那个残忍的婊子，把我纯粹靠运气得来的一些馈赠偷走吧。

lines.en: : What about other students?
lines.zh: : 那其他学生呢？

lines.en: : Other students?
lines.zh: : 其他学生？

lines.en: : People in situations like Tsuneyo or Molly that just...transfer into the class out of nowhere.
lines.zh: : 像 Tsuneyo 或 Molly 那样，不知从哪儿就……转进班上来的人。

lines.en: scene twowoodendoors10
: What, is ten targets not enough for you? You need even more?
lines.zh: : 怎么，十个目标还不够你用的？你还要更多？

lines.en: : I’m just curious. You said you’d answer my questions.
lines.zh: : 我只是好奇。你说过你会回答我的问题。

lines.en: scene twowoodendoors11
: These are rooftop questions. You’re not supposed to ask them in a place like this.
lines.zh: : 这些是天台问题。你不该在这种地方问的。

lines.en: : Would you prefer I didn’t ask them at all and-
lines.zh: : 那你是希望我干脆别问——

lines.en: : It’s not possible.
lines.zh: : 那不可能。

lines.en: : It’s either ten or twelve.
lines.zh: : 要么是十个，要么是十二个。

lines.en: : Taking on any more than that would be extremely problematic for me.
lines.zh: : 再多的话，对我来说就非常麻烦了。

lines.en: : For you? Why would it be a problem for you?
lines.zh: : 对你来说？为什么会对你来说麻烦？

lines.en: scene twowoodendoors2
: That’s another rooftop-question, I’m afraid. And even then it’s unlikely I’d answer it.
lines.zh: : 恐怕那又是一个天台问题。而且就算到了天台上，我也不太可能回答。

lines.en: : Why not?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Do you really need to ask?
lines.zh: : 你真的需要问吗？

lines.en: : I don’t trust you.
lines.zh: : 我不信任你。

lines.en: : We’re not friends.
lines.zh: : 我们不是朋友。

lines.en: : We’re no closer than we were the first time you came to the shrine.
lines.zh: : 比起你第一次来神社的时候，我们并没有更亲近。

lines.en: : You just know slightly more about me.
lines.zh: : 你只是稍微多了解了我一点。

lines.en: : But, in your own words, even those things are just additions to your ever-growing list of things to forget.
lines.zh: : 但用你自己的话来说，就连那些也只不过是你那张不断变长的「遗忘清单」上的新增条目。

lines.en: : Aren’t they, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 不是吗，Sensei？

lines.en: The way the last words roll off her tongue makes her sound like some sort of serpent.
lines.zh: 她吐出最后那几个字的方式，让她听起来像某种蛇。

lines.en: Venom seeps from her fangs and into my skin, thickening my blood to the point where it can no longer circulate.
lines.zh: 毒液从她的獠牙渗入我的皮肤，让我的血液浓稠到再也无法流动。

lines.en: I die as she watches and then slithers away without even consuming her prey.
lines.zh: 我在她的注视下死去，而她连猎物都不吃，就这么游走了。

lines.en: : Umm...S-Sensei? You in there?
lines.zh: : 嗯……S-Sensei？您在里面吗？

lines.en: : Oh. I didn’t know you were expecting someone.
lines.zh: : 哦。我不知道你还在等人。

lines.en: : Neither did I.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道。

lines.en: : Oh, crap. Uhh, I can hear you guys in there so I’ll just go-
lines.zh: : 哦，糟糕。呃，我听得见你们在里面，那我就先——

lines.en: : It’s fine, Miku. Give me a few minutes.
lines.zh: : 没事，Miku。给我几分钟。

lines.en: : Umm...okay...
: Am I being kicked out?
lines.zh: : 我这是被赶走了？

lines.en: : Would you rather stay?
lines.zh: : 你更想留下？

lines.en: : Good point. Not really.
lines.zh: : 说得也是。并不想。

lines.en: : I’ve said all I’ve come to say.
lines.zh: : 我要说的都说完了。

lines.en: : Aside from one thing, that is.
lines.zh: : 除了一件事之外。

lines.en: : And what’s that one thing, Maya?
lines.zh: : 那件事是什么，Maya？

lines.en: scene twowoodendoors12
She looks away and remains silent.
lines.zh: 她别过脸去，陷入沉默。

lines.en: It lasts another seven seconds, just like when she closed her eyes.
lines.zh: 沉默又持续了七秒，和她闭眼时一样长。

lines.en: Then her mouth opens and the venom pours out once again.
lines.zh: 然后她张开嘴，毒液再一次倾泻而出。

lines.en: : The second time can be rough.
lines.zh: : 第二次可能会很艰难。

lines.en: : You might find it harder to breathe than normal.
lines.zh: : 你可能会觉得呼吸比平时困难。

lines.en: : Your legs might feel weak. Your stomach may feel as if it’s being tied into knots.
lines.zh: : 你的腿可能会发软。你的胃可能会像是被打成了结。

lines.en: : But if you make it to the rooftop...
lines.zh: : 但如果你能撑到天台……

lines.en: scene twowoodendoors13
: Never mind.
lines.zh: : 没什么。

lines.en: : I’ll see you at karaoke.
lines.zh: : 我们卡拉 OK 见。

lines.en: scene twowoodendoors1
: Karaoke?
lines.zh: : 卡拉 OK？

lines.en: Maya exits the room before her train of thought ever reaches its destination.
lines.zh: 在她那串思绪抵达终点之前，Maya 就走出了房间。

lines.en: Or perhaps it did reach its destination, and that’s precisely why she left in the first place.
lines.zh: 又或许它确实抵达了终点，而这恰恰就是她离开的原因。

lines.en: There’s no way to tell with her.
lines.zh: 她这个人，根本无从判断。

lines.en: She’s a strange girl.
lines.zh: 她是个奇怪的女孩。

lines.en: Or rather-
lines.zh: 或者说——

lines.en: Completely and irrefutably normal.
lines.zh: 完全且无可辩驳地正常。

lines.en: : Umm...Is it okay for me to come in now?
lines.zh: : 嗯……我现在可以进来吗？

lines.en: : Go ahead, Miku. The door is open.
lines.zh: : 进来吧，Miku。门开着。

lines.en: scene twowoodendoors14
Another girl makes her way into my room for what appears to be the first time.
lines.zh: 又有一个女孩走进了我的房间，看起来是第一次。

lines.en: I can’t confirm whether she’s been here for other Senseis or not, but I know from things she’s told me that she doesn’t particularly like it in here.
lines.zh: 我无法确认她是否为别的 Sensei 来过这里，但从她告诉我的事来看，我知道她并不太喜欢这个地方。

lines.en: Whatever brought her in must be serious.
lines.zh: 能把她带进来的事，一定很严重。

lines.en: : Sorry to bother you...I know you were busy with Maya and stuff.
lines.zh: : 抱歉打扰您……我知道您正忙着和 Maya 说事情。

lines.en: : It’s fine. Maya was just being Maya.
lines.zh: : 没事。Maya 就是那个 Maya。

lines.en: : Is something wrong?
lines.zh: : 出什么事了吗？

lines.en: : Mhm. Somethin’ is really heckin’ wrong, but not with me.
lines.zh: : 嗯。确实出了很他妈严重的问题，不过不是我。

lines.en: Not with her?...
lines.zh: 不是她？……

lines.en: : Makoto, then?
lines.zh: : 那是 Makoto？

lines.en: : Is this about how she was acting in class yesterday?
lines.zh: : 是跟她昨天在课堂上的样子有关吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. She slept through all of today so it wasn’t really a big problem but...I’d be lyin’ if I said I wasn’t a little worried.
lines.zh: : 嗯。她今天睡了一整天，所以倒也没惹出什么大麻烦，不过……要说我一点都不担心，那是在撒谎。

lines.en: : And by “a little worried” I mean I’m really friggin’ worried. I’ve never seen her like this before and she won’t even tell me what’s goin’ on.
lines.zh: : 而且我说的「一点担心」，其实是真的该死的担心。我从没见过她这副样子，她还什么都不肯跟我说。

lines.en: : Weirdo even unplugged our alarm clock for no reason and now I’ve gotta use my phone to get up in the morning.
lines.zh: : 这怪胎还无缘无故把我们的闹钟插头拔了，现在我早上得靠手机起床。

lines.en: : And you think there’s something I can do about this?
lines.zh: : 你觉得这事我能帮上忙？

lines.en: scene twowoodendoors15
: Kinda...yeah...
lines.zh: : 算是吧……嗯……

lines.en: : More than I can do at least...
lines.zh: : 至少比我管用……

lines.en: : I’ve told ya how much she likes you and all that...
lines.zh: : 我跟您说过她有多喜欢您什么的……

lines.en: : Ever since her dad started bangin’ aliens in space, she’s looked at you as some kinda stand-in. Just a stand-in that she has some pretty raunchy thoughts about at times, apparently.
lines.zh: : 自从她爸跑到太空里去操外星人之后，她就把您当成某种替身了。显然，还是一个她时不时会冒出些黄色念头的替身。

lines.en: : I take it this means the best friend blowjob duo isn’t happening?
lines.zh: : 这么说，好闺蜜双人吹箫的戏码是没戏了？

lines.en: scene twowoodendoors16
: Be serious, Sensei! This is a big deal!
lines.zh: : 您正经点，Sensei！这可是大事！

lines.en: : Makoto’s always the one lookin’ out for me when I’m gettin’ all weird so bein’ on the opposite end of the stick is makin’ me really scared!
lines.zh: : 我发神经的时候一直是 Makoto 在照顾我，现在角色反过来，我真的吓坏了！

lines.en: scene twowoodendoors17
: Like, if it’s this hard for me to do anything about her, I can only imagine what it must be like havin’ to hold me down against the bed so I don’t tear all of my hair out.
lines.zh: : 就是说，我对她束手无策都这么难受，那她要把我按在床上、不让我把自己的头发扯光的时候，该有多难，我简直不敢想。

lines.en: : Just...pull her aside and give her a big hug or somethin’.
lines.zh: : 您就……把她拉到一边，给她一个大大的拥抱什么的。

lines.en: : Maybe read her a new article about climate change. Idunno. Stuff Makoto would be into.
lines.zh: : 要不给她读一篇关于气候变化的新文章。我也不知道。反正挑 Makoto 会喜欢的那些东西。

lines.en: : I can try but...that girl’s really only opened up to me twice. And the second time she got all weird out of nowhere and-
lines.zh: : 我可以试试，不过……那丫头真正对我敞开心扉也就两次。而第二次她突然就变得很奇怪，然后——

lines.en: Wait a second...
lines.zh: 等等……

lines.en: That’s exactly when she started acting strange, isn’t it?
lines.zh: 她就是从那时候开始变得不对劲的，不是吗？

lines.en: It wasn’t until after our conversation on the roof that Maki started spotting differences in her behavior.
lines.zh: 是在我们天台上那次谈话之后，Maki 才开始察觉到她行为上的异常。

lines.en: And then there was the incident in class.
lines.zh: 然后是课堂上那件事。

lines.en: But all she did was ask me to close my eyes and then...started crying and got all quiet.
lines.zh: 可她只是让我闭上眼睛，然后……就开始哭，接着整个人安静了下来。

lines.en: What happened?
lines.zh: 到底发生了什么？

lines.en: scene twowoodendoors18
: Sensei? What’s up? You remember somethin’?
lines.zh: : Sensei？怎么了？您想起什么了吗？

lines.en: : Kind of.
lines.zh: : 算是吧。

lines.en: : The two of us had a talk on the rooftop recently about where Makoto thinks her future is going and how she misses her dad.
lines.zh: : 我们俩最近在天台上聊过一次，聊的是 Makoto 觉得自己的人生会走向何方，还有她有多想念她父亲。

lines.en: : I guess...all of that is just getting to her?
lines.zh: : 我想……这些事大概都在折磨着她吧？

lines.en: scene twowoodendoors19
: No...I don’t think somethin’ that small would get to Makoto. She’s used to carryin’ all kinds of burdens.
lines.zh: : 不……我不觉得这种小事能压垮 Makoto。她早就习惯扛着各种各样的重担了。

lines.en: : It’s gotta be somethin’ else. Or maybe puberty is just makin’ it worse or somethin’. I don’t friggin’ know.
lines.zh: : 一定是别的原因。要不就是青春期让情况更糟了什么的。我他妈也不知道。

lines.en: : Just thinkin’ about it this much makes my head hurt.
lines.zh: : 光是想这么多，我脑袋就开始疼了。

lines.en: scene twowoodendoors20
: Could you at least try talkin’ to her if ya get a second? You don’t need to say I came here or anything.
lines.zh: : 您要是能抽出空，至少试着跟她谈谈行吗？您不用告诉她我来过什么的。

lines.en: : Just have it be a you thing.
lines.zh: : 就当成是您自己想去找她。

lines.en: : I’m super duper worried and I just want her to go back to normal so I can go back to bein’ all hyper and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我真的是担心死了，我只想让她赶紧恢复正常，这样我也能回到那个疯疯癫癫的自己。

lines.en: : I’m a really bad babysitter. I don’t know how people do it.
lines.zh: : 我真是个糟糕的看护。不知道别人是怎么做到的。

lines.en: : Sure. I’ll talk to her soon.
lines.zh: : 好。我很快就去跟她谈。

lines.en: : Thanks for coming all the way over here just to tell me that.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你特地跑这一趟，就为了跟我说这些。

lines.en: scene twowoodendoors21
: You don’t gotta thank me...I’m just doin’ what any best friend would do...
lines.zh: : 您不用谢我……我只是做了一个好朋友该做的事……

lines.en: : And I kinda trust you when it comes to all this adult stuff so...there’s not anyone else I can think of who’d be able to help right now.
lines.zh: : 而且这种大人的事我还挺信任您的，所以……现在我想不出还有谁能帮上忙。

lines.en: scene twowoodendoors22
: But, uhh...I’m not tryin’ to get all sappy outta nowhere so I’ll just...be on my way, I guess!
lines.zh: : 不过，呃……我也不是突然想煽情什么的，那我就……先走了！

lines.en: : Thanks for hearin’ me out, Sensei! Forget I ever came here and...remember to look both ways when crossin’ the street and stuff!
lines.zh: : 谢谢您听我说完，Sensei！就当我从没来过，还有……过马路记得左右看什么的！

lines.en: scene twowoodendoors1
: Sayonara! Let me know if you hear anythin’!
lines.zh: : 再见！要是有什么消息记得告诉我！

lines.en: : Or don’t! I don’t know!
lines.zh: : 或者别告诉我！我也不知道！

lines.en: : Uhhhhh goodbye!
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃再见！

lines.en: Miku sprints out of the room at a pace I don’t even usually see her break out during soccer practice.
lines.zh: Miku 冲出房间的速度，连足球训练时我都没怎么见她使出来过。

lines.en: It’s good knowing that she cares that much about her friend, but...
lines.zh: 知道她这么在乎自己的朋友是件好事，不过……

lines.en: I hope she hasn’t placed too much faith in me.
lines.zh: 希望她没有在我身上寄托太多信任。

lines.en: I’m not great when it comes to solving other peoples’ problems.
lines.zh: 解决别人的问题，我可不擅长。

lines.en: Is that something someone in my position, atop a chair with slightly-scratchy fabric and behind two wooden doors, should be saying?
lines.zh: 坐在一把布料微微发痒的椅子上、躲藏在两扇木门后面的人，说这种话合适吗？

lines.en: Of course not.
lines.zh: 当然不合适。

lines.en: But I say it regardless.
lines.zh: 但我还是说了。

lines.en: scene black
And then I close my eyes for a total of seven seconds.
lines.zh: 然后我闭上眼睛，一共七秒。

lines.en: Just as many as Maya closed hers for while dodging my rooftop questions in a non-rooftop setting.
lines.zh: 和 Maya 在非天台场合回避我的天台问题时，闭眼的时间一样长。

lines.en: And I think of what I can do for Makoto.
lines.zh: 我思考着自己能为 Makoto 做些什么。

lines.en: Nothing comes to mind.
lines.zh: 什么也想不出来。

lines.en: I give up.
lines.zh: 我放弃了。

lines.en: I leave[school].
lines.zh: 我离开了[school]。

lines.en: I will talk to her soon.
lines.zh: 我很快就会去找她谈。

$ miku_love += 1
Miku’s affection has increased to [miku_love]!
lines.zh: Miku 的好感度提升到了 [miku_love]！
